answer_1.quote: The task of word alignment is to find lexicon translation equivalents from parallel corpus . It is one of the fundamental tasks in natural language processing (NLP) and is widely studied by the community .

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the alignment quality of our methods with Alignment Error Rate (Och and Ney, 2000, AER). ... we also evaluate our methods on dictionary-guided decoding, a downstream task of alignment induction, with the metric BLEU .
